msgs.text: I am ready to review finished work and enforce peer review requirements. Please ensure you get a genuine code check from a colleague before marking any ticket DONE.

I am currently working on T07 and T05 with partial test passes. I will need a peer review for both tickets before marking them done, so please let me know if you have capacity to check my diffs later in the sprint.
I am working on T03 and T11. Since you own T01 transaction parser, please review my monthly summary logic once I fix the failing tests for T03.
I have T12 and T09 in progress. Who is available to peer review my test fixtures once they are passing?

I can review your diffs for T07 and T05 once you have green builds. In return, could you please check my work on T04 and T02 when they are ready?

Propose your peer review pairings now to ensure everyone has a designated reviewer ready for when their tickets are stable. I need specific names assigned to each ticket owner so we can track compliance and avoid last-minute blockers.

Reminder that peer reviews must be genuine with actual test execution and diff reading before marking tickets DONE. I will verify compliance for the sprint bonus and encourage workers to finalize review pairings soon.
